summary: 12 checks run (4 backend, 8 browser) covering all 8 acceptance criteria. 11 passed, 1 blocked due to a testing-tool hard timeout (120s) colliding with the documented 60-200s headless map-load time for /play/b-ascent-hold; supporting code-level evidence confirms the boundary clamp logic is implemented correctly.

checks.criterion: Workshop library lists built-in scenarios grouped by map with images
checks.name: workshop-library-groups
checks.evidence: Range group shows mode images (gridshot/flick/tracking/strafe.jpg), map-group-ascent shows /maps/ascent/thumb.jpg, filter-map-range filters list, filter-favorites and filter-unplayed visible, search-input filters. Screenshot confirms visually.

checks.criterion: Workshop library lists built-in scenarios grouped by map with images (data layer)
checks.name: test_tscheck_scenario_library.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/scenarios returns 39 builtin scenarios incl. b-range-gridshot/flick/tracking/strafe and ascent map; POST /api/scenarios/{id}/favorite with {favorite:true} returns 200 and favorite:true, verified persisted via GET. Fixture scenario deleted after test.

checks.criterion: Scenario flow: intro -> loading -> click to start -> HUD -> results
checks.name: scenario-play-flow-results
checks.evidence: /play/b-range-gridshot: intro-play-btn -> start-btn after loading -> clicked start -> hud-score/hud-timer/hud-ammo/hud-minimap/hud-fps all visible -> window.__engine.finish(true) -> results-panel with result-score visible. Console shows expected 'user gesture required for Pointer Lock' (documented as expected in headless, not a bug).

checks.criterion: Scenario flow records persistence (record is POSTed and appears on /records)
checks.name: records-page-shows-table
checks.evidence: curl http://localhost:8001/api/records shows the record created by the play-flow check (scenario_id b-range-gridshot, id d4021819-...) persisted; /records page shows records-table with matching row count (4).

checks.name: test_tscheck_record_flow.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/records with scenario_id=b-range-gridshot, score=12345 returns 200 with created id; GET /api/records list contains that id.

checks.criterion: Enemies take damage (hitboxes on agent models)
checks.name: target-damage-on-hit
checks.evidence: On /play/b-range-strafe after start, aimed __engine.yaw/pitch at live target head using target.root.position + hit[0].position, called tryFire(true) with nextFire=0: fireOutcome={"hpBefore":150,"hpAfter":-10,"died":true,"killsBefore":0,"killsAfter":1}. HP dropped, target died, kills incremented.

checks.criterion: Deterministic first shot and spray pattern
checks.name: deterministic-first-shot-crosshair
checks.evidence: Standing still (vel=0, onGround=true), 3 consecutive tryFire(true) calls with nextFire reset each time: first shot aim stayed exactly at crosshair (yaw=0,pitch=0); repeating the identical sequence from a fresh reset produced an identical yaw/pitch sequence both runs, confirming no Math.random dependency when standing still.

checks.criterion: Buy menu: weapons + shields only; skin window separate
checks.name: buy-menu-weapons-shields
checks.evidence: open-buy-btn opens buy-menu showing weapon columns (buy-weapon-vandal etc.) and buy-shield-heavy; clicking buy-weapon-vandal shows buy-detail-panel with fire rate/mag/run speed/reload/damage-by-distance table (screenshot confirms).

checks.name: skin-window-vandal-skins
checks.evidence: rail-skins (sidebar, clicked while buy-menu closed) opens skin-window separate from buy menu; switching to skin-weapon-vandal shows exactly 10 skin-option-* cards; vm-*-slider, glb-upload-input and fp-agent-select all present/attached.

checks.name: settings-crosshair-code-sensitivity
checks.evidence: settings-search filters rows (typed 'hassasiyet', only sensitivity rows shown); changing sensitivity input to 0.567 updated sens-quick-btn top-bar value to 0.567; ch-code-input filled with '0;P;c;5;h;0;0l;4;0o;2;0a;1;0f;0;1b;0' + ch-code-import turned the live crosshair preview cyan (screenshot confirms).

checks.name: settings-keybind-capture
checks.evidence: Control tab keybind-table visible; clicked bind-<action>-0 button (showed 'W'), entered capture mode ('Press key...'), pressed KeyG, button text changed to 'G'.

checks.name: test_tscheck_settings_persist.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/settings with a tscheck marker + sensitivity=0.42 returns 200; subsequent GET /api/settings returns the same marker and sensitivity=0.42.

checks.name: minimap-boundary-clamp
checks.evidence: Two attempts both hit the browser-check tool's ~120s hard execution ceiling while waiting for /play/b-ascent-hold's map GLB to load (briefing documents 60-200s headless load time for map scenarios) — the tool itself times out before the app can even reach start-btn. Could not be exercised live within this tool's budget. Supporting code evidence (frontend/src/game/engine.ts lines 289, 625): hold-type scenarios set `this.limit = {x, z, r: 2.5}`, and the per-frame tick clamps `pos` back inside the radius and sets `boundT` (which drives the 'bounds' HUD message) whenever `d > L.r` — matching the criterion's expected behavior. hud-minimap itself was independently confirmed rendering in the range-scenario HUD check.

checks.name: editor-create-save-delete
checks.evidence: /editor: filled editor-name-input with unique name, editor-map-select=range, editor-type-input=gridshot, clicked editor-save-btn -> URL became /editor/<id>; new scenario appeared in Workshop search by name; clicked editor-delete-btn -> confirmed via curl GET /api/scenarios/<id> returning 404 (fully removed, no residue).

checks.name: preview-url-workshop-smoke
checks.evidence: Loaded https://memorable-6.preview.emergentagent.com/ directly and confirmed map-group-range renders, proving the public ingress path works end-to-end.

action_items.item: minimap-boundary-clamp check is environment-blocked: the run_browser_script tool enforces a hard ~120s execution ceiling, but headless map scenario loads (e.g. /play/b-ascent-hold) are documented to take 60-200s. Re-run this check manually with a longer-budget tool/session, or consider adding a lighter-weight map fixture for automated testing of map-scenario boundary logic.
